marketRetention.requirement: Each run persists permitted raw source responses or a lossless normalized equivalent, plus acquisition metadata, source terms status, content hashes, and the transformation/configuration hashes used by the output.
marketRetention.publicExposure: Raw inputs, source URLs containing credentials, and licensed record-level evidence are never copied into either public namespace.
marketRetention.unavailableRaw: If terms prohibit raw retention, persist the normalized equivalent, exact retrieval metadata, raw-retention status, and hash when legally available; the run remains ineligible for cutover if independent reproduction is not possible.

migration.legacyPolicy: Legacy paths and artifacts remain read-only and unchanged. Version 2.0.0 writes only to its isolated namespaces.
migration.dualRun: Sessions 18 and 19 may implement and exercise v2 in parallel, but must not replace, alias over, or reinterpret legacy production outputs.
migration.backfill: A replay is a new version-stamped run referencing immutable source identities; it never mutates an earlier run.
migration.cutover: No cutover, public publication, or legacy retirement is authorized by this candidate.

locking.implementationRule: Use an atomic exclusive-create lock record bound to runId and owner. Any existing lock blocks the writer.
locking.recovery: There is no automatic stale-lock takeover. Recovery requires a persisted human decision and a new run; the abandoned run remains intact.

atomicPublication: A public versioned manifest is written last and references already durable content-addressed artifacts. Readers reject missing, mismatched, or mixed-version members.
unresolvedBackend: The durable private storage backend, tiering, retention duration, and disaster-recovery service level remain deferred. Until resolved, implementation may use access-controlled local storage with no pruning; cutover is blocked.
